Hi Mina,

- Confirm resource owners for integrations (API access + SSO).
- Agree on a hard cutover weekend (we're proposing the weekend of Nov 20).
- Validate the acceptance criteria for Phase 1 (search + chat).

I can share the SOW if that helps — attaching the latest redline (v3). Also included a short list of dependencies: security review (internal), test data subset, and staging access.

Subject: Kestrel Systems — MAP (draft) + proposed milestones

Sam / Tom —

Thanks for the SOW and the call. I attached a draft MAP spreadsheet ("MAP-draft-kestrel-20261001.xlsx") and pasted a condensed version below so we can iterate quickly in-thread. This draft assumes the Nov 20 weekend as the primary cutover window; if that changes we can shift milestones by two weeks without impacting scope.

Condensed MAP (Phase / Milestone / Owner / Target date):
- Phase 0 — Procurement sign & SOW counter-signed / Jordan Blake / 2026-10-08
- Phase 1 — Staging provisioned + baseline tests / Ben Carter (CS Eng) / 2026-10-22
- Phase 1 — API keys & sample dataset loaded / Kestrel infra / 2026-10-29
- Phase 2 — Integration validation (SSO, logging hooks) / Ben Carter / 2026-11-05
- Cutover prep — Dry-run & rollback test / Mina Haddad / 2026-11-15
- Cutover — Weekend execution / Joint (Redwood ops + Kestrel infra) / 2026-11-20 to 2026-11-22
- Post-cutover — Validation & SLA handover / Mina + Kestrel PM / 2026-11-25

Notes / open items:
1) Security/compliance: Jordan, can you confirm which artifacts Kestrel needs for the SOC2 checklist?
2) Staging data: Sam, please confirm the 2k-row sample and whether PII is scrubbed.
3) Escalation path: We'll run a daily 30-minute bridge during the cutover weekend; suggest 06:00-06:30 PT start for alignment.

Ben will own integration-failure playbook and run the rollback rehearsal; Jordan will shepherd procurement and SOW finalization. I've kept the dates conservative to allow for procurement slack.

If that looks good, reply-all with any redlines and we'll finalize tomorrow.

Cheers,
Mina

--

Adding a couple of operational details:

- Integration owners: I'll be primary for the API/ingest work (Ben Carter). I'll have one engineer (TBD) dedicated for Sprint 0 + dry-run.
- Runbook: I'll prepare a one-page rollback checklist and share it by Tuesday (2026-10-06).
- Test plan: Can Kestrel provide the exact sample payloads? If not, Jordan, we can provide a sanitized set for baseline pass/fail.

Risk callouts:
- If procurement extends beyond 2026-10-12 we will need to compress the staging validation week (risk to Nov cutover). Recommend Jordan expedite signatures or sign a provisional SOW to reserve capacity.
- SSO: If Kestrel uses a non-standard SAML attribute mapping, we'll need a short adapter sprint (add 1 week).

I'll also join the procurement call if helpful. Mina — I'll slot in the dry-run date on our calendar once Jordan confirms procurement cadence.

Ben

- Sample data: Sam confirmed — 2,000 rows, PII scrubbed. He'll upload to the Drive link in the next hour.

- Cutover weekend: Confirmed — Nov 20-22 looks workable. We'll staff our infra lead for the 06:00 PT bridge both days.
